services.heading: What I handle
items: Emergency shutoffs and water damage stops

about.heading: Straight answers. No runaround.
body: Pat is a solo, fully licensed Massachusetts plumber based in Winthrop. He takes emergency calls and side work across Essex County and the greater Boston area — a travel service, not a shop you drive to.
You talk to him directly, get a clear read on the job, and he shows up ready to fix it. Sixteen years of experience. No travel fee games. No surprise salesman pitch.
highlights: Talk to the owner — not a dispatcher
